notes: Stories validated; no duplicates; full coverage across schema, logic, integration, API, and tests.

stories.title: Define Multi-Cluster Routing Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define configuration schema for multiple MongoDB clusters including cluster roles (primary, secondary, analytics), explicit dataset-to-cluster mappings (providers, embeddings, logs), environment prefix handling, and routing rules. Establish a strict contract requiring all services to request clusters by dataset capability (not connection string) to enforce governance.

stories.title: Implement Cluster Routing and Selection Logic
stories.description: Build routing engine that deterministically selects the correct MongoDB cluster based on dataset type, read/write intent, and environment. Enforce no cross-cluster leakage, include cluster role awareness, and define explicit failover behavior when a cluster is unavailable.

stories.title: Integrate Routing Logic with Mongo Utilities
stories.description: Integrate routing engine into shared MongoDB utilities so all database access flows through governed cluster selection. Enforce routing at the utility layer, ensuring compatibility with connection lifecycle management, ping validation, and context manager usage.

stories.title: Expose Routing Configuration and Health Signals
stories.description: Provide internal-only API/config access to expose active routing decisions, dataset-to-cluster mappings, and cluster health status for observability and debugging. Ensure read-only access and no external UI exposure.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Multi-Cluster Routing
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating deterministic cluster selection across dataset types, read/write paths, and environments. Include failover simulations, dual-cluster isolation validation, and enforcement that all access routes through governed utilities.
